title.narrative: Drainage in Sao Paulo, II Stage
Drenaje en Sao Paulo, Etapa II

description.narrative: THE OBJECTIVE IS TO IMPROVE CURRENT URBAN AND ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS IN CREEKS IN THE CITY OF SAO PAULO, REDUCE THE RISK OF FLOODING, RELOCATE LOW INCOME POPULATIONS AND IMPROVE URBAN ROADS. TO ACHIEVE THOSE OBJECTIVES IT IS FORESEEN TO CHANNEL 14 CREEKS, TO IMPROVE THE DRAINAGE SYSTEM, TO BUILD ROADS AND RELOCATE FAMILIES IN NEW HOUSING UNITS.
